title: Eyes Up Ready (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Eyes up ready eyes up ready
Watch the paddle face stay steady
Eyes up ready eyes up ready
Read the spin keep it heady

[Verse 1]
Eyes up watch the rival paddle face
Thats where the next ball will trace
Dont watch the ball watch the angle
The paddle tells the next tangle
Vamos vamos ojos arriba
Eyes up ready follow the diva
Closed paddle face ball will go down
Open paddle face ball will be flown

[Pre-Chorus]
Eyes up eyes up
Read the paddle cup
Eyes up eyes up
Never shut up

[Chorus]
Eyes up ready watch the paddle path
Eyes up ready do the math
Eyes up ready read the angle in time
Eyes up ready half a second sublime
Vamos vamos pa lante
Eyes up ready
Vamos vamos pa lante
Focus heavy steady

[Verse 2]
Watch the rival shoulder turn first
Thats the early read for the burst
Then the paddle face shows the line
Reaction time half a second fine
Uno dos tres see the angle
React to the paddle never get strangled
Anticipate dont just react
Thats how you stay one step intact

[Bridge]
Common error watching just the ball
Thats too late for the call
Watch the paddle head the contact zone
Anticipate where the ball is thrown

[Chorus]
Eyes up ready watch the paddle path
Eyes up ready do the math
Eyes up ready read the angle in time
Eyes up ready half a second sublime

[Outro]
Eyes up ready eyes up ready
Watch the paddle face stay steady
Eyes up ready eyes up ready
Read the spin keep it heady
